description.value:
The Sharingan's signature: with active dōjutsu eyes, you observe and instantly internalize a jutsu cast within line of sight.

Trigger A creature within 60 feet of you completes the casting of a jutsu of rank equal to or less than your spell rank.

You attempt to learn the triggering jutsu. Make a Perception check against the triggering creature's spell DC. On a success, you can attempt to cast that jutsu once before the end of your next long rest (treat it as a known spell of your highest rank slot or lower). On a failure, you gain a +2 status bonus to your next Perception check against the same caster's jutsu in this encounter.

Some jutsu (those with the kekkei genkai trait, those with the uchiha trait, true dōjutsu) cannot be copied this way.

system.requirements: active Sharingan; can see the casting clearly
